findings.evidence: Audio and image fields use deterministic placeholder UUIDs and the runner is explicitly profile-gated.
findings.why_it_matters: A full delivery walkthrough cannot play or display those prompts until matching media objects exist.
findings.required_action: Upload generic demo media and replace the placeholder references in a separate media-backed E2E fixture workflow.

findings.evidence: The runner uses @Profile("seed-full-exam") and checks a stable blueprint sentinel before writing.
findings.why_it_matters: Seed content must not silently enter normal or production deployments.
findings.required_action: Enable the profile only in local/dev workflows and keep it absent from production deployment configuration.

findings.evidence: Unit tests verify fixture mapping and idempotency, but no live database/media stack was invoked.
findings.why_it_matters: Repository mocks do not prove actual JPA persistence, snapshot publication, or media availability.
findings.required_action: Run the existing local E2E seed/media workflow against a clean stack before relying on the blueprint for manual exam execution.

receipt_note: The plan/report lives in pte-doc while reviewed source and tests live in pte-api, a separate git repository under the pte-org parent.
